properties.sfomuseum:description: Two-page advertisement from May 14, 1949 issue of Collier’s magazine promoting Pan American World Airways, titled “A world premiere by Pan American World Airways / First to order and to fly the new double-decked Clipper ‘America’”; color illustration depicting passengers seated in aircraft cabin with additional images of club lounge and cross section cutaway rendering of Boeing 377 Stratocruiser aircraft.
